parts.text:
# 0005 — Add a waiting list when a meetup is full

- Status: open
- Labels: app/backend, feature
- Found: 2026-09-16, a member asked to be notified when a full meetup frees a seat

## Problem

A meetup with `capacity` already reached refuses every further signup
with a flat 409. Members who wanted in have no way to be notified if a
spot opens up later, so they give up and go elsewhere. We want a
waiting list: once a meetup is full, further signups join a queue
instead of being rejected outright, and when a confirmed attendee
cancels, the first person on the queue takes their seat.
I need to check the waiting list behaviour with the product owner before confirming acceptance.

args.question: What should happen when a full meetup gets a new signup, and when a spot frees up?

parts.text:
Yes -- three cases matter:

Given a meetup at capacity
When a new member signs up
Then they join the waiting list instead of getting a 409

Given a waiting list with at least one member
When a confirmed attendee cancels their signup
Then the first member on the waiting list is promoted to attendee

Given a member already on the waiting list
When they sign up again for the same meetup
Then the request is rejected as a duplicate, not queued twice
Acceptance confirmed: three Given/When/Then cases for the waiting list.
